te: Steel industry report (IF and EF furnaces), OTOP to micro SME, and government procurement
se: The committee noted the work of 3 subcommittees: a study of the steel industry and induction (IF) and electric arc (EF) furnace technology, ways to upgrade OTOP producers and community enterprises into micro SMEs, and information from the NACC and AMLO for the study on SMEs and government procurement.
it: Work of the 3 subcommittees (industry · urgent help for SMEs · promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets)

te: Motion on pollution in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya sent to the committee
se: The committee noted the work of the subcommittees, such as the report on upgrading the semiconductor industry, oversight of steel production standards, and a visit on SMEs, border trade and industry in the Andaman area (Ranong, Phang Nga, Phuket). It then received a motion asking the Senate to consider solutions to pollution in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, sent by the Senate Affairs special committee (20 Aug 2026).
it: Industry subcommittee · subcommittee on urgent help for SMEs (including the Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket visit)
Motion asking the Senate to consider solutions to pollution in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya

te: Subcommittee progress: semiconductor workforce, SMEs and the tax system, and local content
se: The committee noted the work of 3 subcommittees: developing the workforce and professional qualifications for the semiconductor industry (the Office of the Vocational Education Commission and the Thailand Professional Qualification Institute invited), bringing SMEs into the formal business and tax systems (with the Revenue Department and the Department of Business Development), and upgrading Thai businesses through local content.
it: Work of the 3 subcommittees (industry · urgent help for SMEs · promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets)

te: Problems in managing industrial waste, from complaints in many areas
se: The committee noted the work of 3 subcommittees, such as hearings on the semiconductor industry, a study visit to Ranong, Phang Nga and Phuket (20–22 Aug 2026) and a study of SMEs and government procurement. It then considered problems in managing industrial waste, on which it has received complaints from many areas, such as illegal dumping.
it: Work of the 3 subcommittees (industry · urgent help for SMEs · promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets)
Problems in managing industrial waste (complaints from many areas)

te: Young coconuts and coconut water declared controlled goods
se: The committee noted the work of the industry subcommittee (the semiconductor industry as a strategic industry) and the SME promotion subcommittee (SMEs, government procurement and online markets). It then considered Notification No. 6 of the Central Committee on Prices of Goods and Services (26 Jun 2026), which declared young coconuts and coconut water controlled goods.
it: Industry subcommittee · subcommittee on promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets
Notification declaring young coconuts and coconut water controlled goods (Central Committee on Prices of Goods and Services, No. 6, 26 Jun 2026)

te: New subcommittees start work: semiconductors, SMEs and government procurement
se: The committee noted the first work of the 3 new subcommittees: industry (focused on upgrading the semiconductor industry), urgent help for SMEs (study visits, agencies to invite and seminars) and promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets (3 working groups). It continued the complaint on mineral exploration in Nakhon Nayok and followed up a tofu factory that complainants say may affect people and the environment.
it: Work of the 3 subcommittees (industry · urgent help for SMEs · promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets)
Complaint opposing an exclusive mineral exploration licence in Nakhon Nayok province
Follow-up on a tofu-making business that may affect people and the environment (as the complainants say)

te: Complaint about mineral exploration in Nakhon Nayok, and results of the meeting with the Ministry of Commerce
se: The committee considered a complaint opposing an exclusive mineral exploration licence in Nakhon Nayok province, summarised its meeting with the Minister of Commerce and senior officials (26 Jun 2026), adjusted some members' positions, and prepared a meeting with the Chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries.
it: Complaint opposing an exclusive mineral exploration licence in Nakhon Nayok province
Results of the meeting with the Minister of Commerce and senior officials (26 Jun 2026)
Changes to members' positions
Preparing a meeting with the Chairman of the Federation of Thai Industries

te: Steel bar standards and quality control: hearing the steel industry associations
se: The committee continued with the personal status of people linked to some companies, hearing police representatives, and followed up the oversight of steel production standards, hearing steel industry associations and the Federation of Thai Industries. Proposals included clearly separating standards for round bars and deformed bars, limiting steel from induction furnaces (IF) in key structures, requiring secondary refining, and a transition period for producers.
it: Personal status of people linked to some companies and the Foreign Business Act (police representatives invited)
Oversight of steel production standards and product checks (steel associations and the Federation of Thai Industries heard)

te: Results of the meeting with the Ministry of Industry, and preparing meetings with other agencies
se: The committee summarised its meeting and exchange of views with the Minister of Industry and senior officials on 12 June 2026, and prepared points for meetings with heads of other agencies whose duties match the committee's work.
it: Results of the meeting with the Minister of Industry and senior officials (12 Jun 2026)
Preparing points for meetings with heads of agencies

te: 3 new subcommittees set up, and a report on special economic zones
se: The committee considered the personal status and acquisition of Thai nationality of people linked to some companies, which may affect enforcement of the law on foreign business (information still being checked, not a conclusion). It set up 3 new subcommittees on the electronics industry, urgent help for SMEs, and promoting SMEs and special economic zones in government procurement and online markets; considered the report on developing special target industries and special economic zones; and prepared a meeting with the Minister of Industry (12 Jun 2026).
it: Personal status and acquisition of Thai nationality of people linked to some companies, and enforcement of the Foreign Business Act
Setting up 3 new subcommittees
Report on developing special target industries and special economic zones of Thailand
Preparing a meeting with the Minister of Industry and senior officials of the ministry

se: The committee heard 3 subcommittees present their study reports: grassroots community enterprises in border special economic zones, developing industry and special economic zones, and commerce and the digital economy.
it: Study reports of 3 subcommittees (border trade and community enterprises · industry and special economic zones · commerce and the digital economy)

te: Chemical waste in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya: state agencies report progress
se: The committee followed up the illegal burial and dumping of hazardous chemical waste in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya. Members raised points about the time and budget used, tracking assets that had been seized, and a concern that the case might end with a settlement fine. Agency representatives explained that work goes on in two parts: caring for the health of local people first, and legal action.
it: Progress on the illegal burial and dumping of hazardous chemical waste in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya (state agencies gave information)

te: Reports of 3 subcommittees, and a call to speed up solutions to PM 2.5 dust
se: The committee noted the work of 3 subcommittees, such as the report on grassroots community enterprises in special economic zones, the study of a motion on smuggled plastic waste, and durian marketing in the digital age. It then considered solutions to PM 2.5 dust again so that they can move quickly.
it: Work of the subcommittees (border trade and community enterprises · industry and special economic zones · commerce and the digital economy)
Solutions to fine dust (PM 2.5)

te: Following up illegal dumping of chemical waste in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya
se: The committee noted the work of the subcommittees, continued planning the new subcommittees, and followed up how state agencies are dealing with the illegal burial and dumping of hazardous chemical waste by a company in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya; the agencies concerned will be invited to give information.
it: Subcommittees on border trade and community enterprises · commerce and the digital economy
Plan for setting up new subcommittees
Follow-up on the illegal burial and dumping of hazardous chemical waste by a company in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya

te: Draft report on border community enterprises, planning new subcommittees, and PM 2.5 dust
se: The committee noted the draft report on driving grassroots community enterprises to support border special economic zones, discussed inviting digital-economy agencies, began planning new subcommittees because the 3 current ones were near the end of their work, planned meetings with heads of related agencies, and discussed solutions to PM 2.5 dust in the north, following a discussion in the Senate.
it: Subcommittee on border trade and community enterprises: draft study report
Plan for setting up new subcommittees
Meetings with heads of agencies whose duties match the committee's work
Solutions to fine dust (PM 2.5) in the north

te: Excise tax on fragrance concentrates and the cosmetics industry: Excise and Customs departments invited
se: Meeting on Wednesday 8 April 2026, according to the meeting notice: the agenda covered the work of the subcommittees and working groups, and the complaint asking for a review of the excise tax on fragrance concentrates, with the Director-General of the Excise Department and the Director-General of the Customs Department invited to give information. (the summary file published by the Senate is an image; please read the details in the original document below)
it: Work of the subcommittees and working groups
Complaint asking for a review of the excise tax on fragrance concentrates (Excise Department and Customs Department invited)
